label: rem:categorical-dirac-operator-remark
title: Limits of the categorical Dirac operator
html: When q = 1 the categorical Dirac operator reduces to \mathcal{D}_ abla = abla, the undeformed covariant derivative. The q-deformation interpolates between the full connection and its projection onto the Reeb direction: as q o \infty, \mathcal{D}_ abla o \iota_\xi abla, the purely contact component.
